summary.en: Distinguish input, output, auxiliary memory and active recursion frames before judging in-place algorithms.
summary.bn: ইনপুটের জায়গা, বাড়তি মেমরি আর recursion stack-এর খরচ আলাদা করো।

notes: C17 baseline; general algorithm bounds treat input size as variable.

examples.title: Reverse using one temporary value
examples.explanationHtml: Two outer positions are exchanged per round. The middle value stays in place, and no second array is needed.

examples.title: Keep the original while reversing a copy
examples.explanationHtml: The first line preserves the original order. A separate output array allows this, but uses one extra cell per value.

examples.title: Measure live recursive depth
examples.explanationHtml: Sizes 8, 4, 2 and 1 coexist before returns begin. Four live frames differ from the total work of a branching recursion.

practice.title: Reverse a row in place
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..64) and n integers (-99..99). Print Enter n, then n values:, then the reversed values separated by spaces. Use one temporary value and no second array.
hints: Move left and right towards each other.

practice.title: Compact adjacent duplicate scores
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..64) and n sorted integers (-99..99). Print Enter n, then n values:, then keep one value per equal run on one line. Compact inside the same array.
hints: The write position never passes the read position.

practice.title: Explain the Space Complexity invariant
practice.statementHtml: For Space Complexity, state what stays true as the main process repeats. Explain the start, preservation and completed result.
hints: Use the changing boundaries and the processed region in this method.
practice.answerHtml:
Before each reversal iteration, positions outside [left,right] already hold their final reversed values. The remaining interval contains exactly the values still needing reversal. Swapping its two endpoints puts both in their final places, and narrowing the interval preserves the claim. When at most one value remains, every position is correct.

The unfinished interval shrinks by two each time, so the routine terminates. For compaction, a different invariant applies: a[0..used) contains one copy of each distinct value in the processed prefix, and used ≤ i before the next read. This second condition explains why reusing storage is safe.

practice.title: Derive the resource cost of Space Complexity
practice.statementHtml: Compare the live storage for in-place reversal, copied reversal and the halving recursion.
hints: Count the work from this algorithm rather than naming a class alone.
practice.answerHtml: The reversal makes floor(n/2) swaps and uses three integer variables, so it takes Θ(n) time and Θ(1) auxiliary space. The copied reversal also takes Θ(n) time but needs Θ(n) result space under our counting convention. Neither comparison needs exact stack-frame byte sizes. Such sizes depend on the compiler, optimisation choices and calling convention, while growth follows the number of simultaneously live frames.

quiz.prompt: Which storage belongs to auxiliary space for in-place reversal?
options: The saved value and two indices
quiz.explanation: These working variables exist in addition to the input cells.

quiz.prompt: What is the peak stack growth for one recursive call on n - 1?
quiz.explanation: All callers remain active until the zero-size base returns.

quiz.prompt: What is the peak stack growth for sequential balanced binary splitting?
quiz.explanation: Only one root-to-leaf path plus pending callers is active at a time.

quiz.prompt: Why is returning a pointer to a local array invalid?
options: The array lifetime ends when the function returns
quiz.explanation: The pointer would refer to an object that no longer exists.

quiz.prompt: With a shared n-cell merge buffer, what is the extra growth?
quiz.explanation: The buffer dominates the smaller logarithmic call stack.

quiz.prompt: Which property is independent of in-place storage?
quiz.explanation: A stable sort preserves tie order; workspace is a separate property.

quiz.prompt: Why can adjacent-duplicate compaction overwrite its own array safely?
options: Its output is always the same length
Its write position never passes unread input
Its values must all be zero
quiz.explanation: The processed prefix provides enough room for each kept value.

quiz.prompt: What is the first value after reversing [7,3,1] in place?
quiz.explanation: The right endpoint becomes the new left endpoint.

quiz.prompt: How many extra result cells does the copied-reversal plan declare here?
quiz.explanation: The ratio counts elements without assuming a byte size for int.

quiz.prompt: How many live levels belong to the halving chain 16,8,...,1?
quiz.explanation: Four reductions plus the base frame give five levels.

keyPoints.en: Auxiliary space excludes the input storage.
keyPoints.bn: ইনপুটের জায়গা বাদ দিয়ে বাড়তি কাজের মেমরি ধরো।

keyPoints.en: State whether required output space is counted.
keyPoints.bn: আউটপুটের জায়গা হিসাবের মধ্যে আছে কি না বলো।

keyPoints.en: Recursion consumes space through active frames.
keyPoints.bn: সক্রিয় recursive call-এর frame-ও মেমরি নেয়।

keyPoints.en: Sequential phases can reuse released storage.
keyPoints.bn: এক ধাপের মেমরি ছেড়ে দিলে পরের ধাপে তা ব্যবহার করা যায়।

keyPoints.en: In-place and stable mean different things.

examQuestions.question: Reverse [7,3,5,3,1] in place using left and right indices. Show the array after each swap and identify the live auxiliary variables.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
StageStateDecision
Start[7,3,5,3,1]The whole interval is unfinished.
Outer swap[1,3,5,3,7]The two endpoint positions are final.
Inner swap[1,3,5,3,7]Equal 3 values exchange without changing the numbers.
Meet at centreleft = right = 2The middle item belongs to itself.

The auxiliary state is left, right and saved. Each uses one integer cell, independently of input length.
